blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — Four people were arrested and 33 live animals were recovered during an operation against illegal wildlife trading in Taytay, Palawan, authorities said Sunday. The operation was conducted on Friday in Sitio Ibangley, Barangay Abungan, Taytay, by the Palawan Council for Sustainable Development (PCSD), together with the City Mobile Force Company, Police Station 1 of the Puerto Princesa City Police Office, Peace and Security Cluster, Naval Intelligence and Security Group, and the Special Forces of the Armed Forces of the Philippines. Authorities said the operation stemmed from information about the alleged illegal sale of wildlife. An undercover police officer […]...
